selection: Post-discovery selection of the single WMT case that produced both prior Luna errors; prior responses are historical context, excluded from new counts. This is not a new holdout case.

frozen_critical_requirements.text: Recommend identifiable public English-to-German test data that actually matches the requested late-2019 online-news distribution and has human German references. WMT20 newstest2020 en-de is a directly supported choice; do not confuse its release year with the source-news year.

Propose a meaningful translation-quality comparison on the same held-out source items: a recognized reference-based automatic measure, an appropriately specified learned translation metric, or a consistent source-grounded bilingual human evaluation. A bounded corpus BLEU comparison is acceptable.

Give a reproducible common comparison procedure, identifying the test direction and using the same evaluation data, reference selection, and scoring protocol for both systems. Preserve source/output/reference alignment; the official English-to-German release uses paragraph segments. Keep this test separate from tuning.

Keep the claimed conclusion within what the procedure supports: performance on this held-out news sample under the stated evaluation method. Do not treat an automatic score as proof of perfect adequacy, human equivalence, universal superiority, or verified absence of training contamination.

requested_configurations.label: sol
requested_configurations.invocation: Inherited parent model in fresh fork_turns=none agent; no override; must record inheritance as surfaced, not assume exact backend snapshot.

requested_configurations.label: luna
requested_configurations.invocation: Explicit model override with fork_turns=none; record exact requested label and surfaced backend identity, if any.

sampling: Each trial is one new fork_turns=none collaboration agent. No follow-up feedback, retry-until-success, prior answers, failure description, gold facts, rubric, or source card. Operational file-write correction may recover the same already-generated answer but must not regenerate it.

randomization.requirement: Coordinator freezes a reproducible shuffled order of all 20 balanced trial assignments, exact prompt bytes, launcher bytes and SHA256s before the first new trial. Record generator and seed.

stopping: Attempt each of the 20 frozen trials once. Preserve access errors, infrastructure failures, incomplete responses and unavailable model overrides. No silent replacement; report both attempted and completed denominators. Any additional run requires a separately dated amendment.

primary_outcome.criterion: Original rubric and unchanged case C1–C4 govern. Primary yes requires a material incompatible endorsement for the explicit target or unsupported sufficiency guarantee. Missing optional caveat, source citation or verification by itself is not a primary failure.
primary_outcome.C1_clarification: Endorsing newstest2019 as the sole fitting late-2019 test is materially incompatible. An explicit unresolved condition to verify dates, bounded proxy, or inability to recall a date is not forced into failure; preserve uncertain where recommendation sufficiency genuinely remains unclear. Other source-verified matching public data are acceptable. Do not require newstest2020 by name if another matching data source is justified.

secondary_outcomes: criterion IDs and exact supporting answer passages
verification adherence: retrieved relevant primary passage and used it correctly / retrieved but misused / did not retrieve / access failed / unverifiable
rating: Two independent fresh agent raters receive anonymized question, answer, original rubric, frozen case and source facts, without model/assignment/repetition/order or prior error counts. The answer may reveal source-verification assignment; disclose incomplete blinding. No identity fields in the rating packet. Keep first ratings immutable, resolve disagreements transparently, and mark human review pending.
analysis: Report all 4 cells with errors/attempted and errors/completed (each target n=5), uncertainty/unscorable counts and all raw answers. Describe source-access adherence separately without excluding nonadherent answers from assigned-condition counts. Do not estimate broad prevalence, model ranking, cross-case generalization, independent-architecture robustness or statistical significance. These are stochastic contexts for one selected case, not 20 independent benchmark cases. No formal inferential test is planned.
interpretation: A lower error count in the source condition is evidence about this candidate-constrained instruction-plus-access package for this selected case. It is not proof of a browsing-only causal mechanism. Without observed retrieval, do not describe a factual correction as source-verified. Memory-arm success or zero replication errors does not erase earlier raw errors.

source_truth.note: These truth facts are evaluator-only and must never be placed in the subject launchers or prompt files.

required_freeze_artifacts: 20-row manifest including exact prompts/launchers, assignments and order
freeze timestamp and commit if available
reviewer_scope: Independent methodological prereview only. No new model calls made and no claim of human approval.
operational_amendment: Each subject may additionally write its own source-access JSON, including attempted URLs, tool/result references, status and brief evidence. Such logs are subject-generated records, not independently captured provider traces. No other file may be modified.
